question: Who is hosting Exercise Desert Flag-10, which involves the participation of the Indian Air Force and several other countries' air forces?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Arab Emirates (UAE)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Exercise Desert Flag-10 is being hosted by the United Arab Emirates (UAE) Air Force, with participation from various countries, including the Indian Air Force.**
 
• **The exercise aims to undertake complex fighter engagements and exchange operational knowledge with several capable air forces from around the world.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exercise Desert Flag-10 will continue till the 8th of the next month and involves the air forces of Australia, Bahrain, France, Germany, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Republic of Korea, Turkey, UAE, United Kingdom, and the United States of America, in addition to India.**
 
• **The exercise focuses on fighter engagements, operational knowledge exchange, and the sharing of best practices among some of the most capable air forces globally.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Exercise Desert Flag-10__

 __
 
• A multinational air exercise aimed at enhancing combat readiness and improving interoperability between different air forces.
 
 
 
• Indian Air Force (IAF)__
 
 
• The IAF is participating in this exercise alongside several other air forces, showcasing India's air combat capabilities and enhancing operational cooperation with global partners.
